image_description: A brown pelican flying low over a body of water. The bird is captured in profile, moving from left to right. It has dark brown plumage on its body and wings, with a white head and neck. The distinctive long bill with a gular pouch is clearly visible, appearing yellowish-orange. The wings are broad, with the primary flight feathers splayed at the tip. The legs are tucked back against the tail.
